text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tonight is Christmas. At Orfevre's strong 
request, we came to a certain hotel for 
dinner. —To our surprise, she reserved the 
entire venue.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Orfevre's enthusiastic fans 
arranged everything... and as her Trainer, 
I was invited as well.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
choice_data_list: The food was delicious, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The chef and waiter who had been attending 
to us throughout the meal departed... 
leaving the two of us alone.
choice_data_list: ...Come to think of it, where's Journey?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: That's a separate matter.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It is remarkably quiet. My retainers 
even sent LANE messages saying they would 
spend time individually 'so as not to 
disturb the King's relaxing time.'
choice_data_list:
(Thinking about it again, I'm not sure... 
what I should say.)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...That thing of yours. That necklace.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Where did you find it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre's eyes shifted toward her goldwork 
pendant. Apparently, she had been touching 
it without realizing it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking back... since the day I received 
this, I began having strange dreams. And 
they came true, just like prophetic 
visions—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Except for the Japan Cup, which I 
challenged with a renewed resolve. That 
day, for the first time, the dream was 
shattered.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking back on it now, whenever I had 
those prophetic dreams... I believe I was 
always pondering Orfevre's destiny.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told Orfevre about my dream for the 
first time. Far from laughing at such a 
wild story... she simply gave a quiet nod.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I command you. Offer that up to me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Thou claimest thou canst not deliver it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was something I always wore during 
Orfevre's races. Although I had a strong 
attachment to it, strangely enough, I felt 
it belonged in her hands.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Lukewarm.
choice_data_list:
Well, you were wearing it up until just 
now...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Are you curious... why We sought it?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmph. There is no cause for it.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
What belongs to the subjects belongs to 
the king. Or am I mistaken?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Then you should understand.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Your heart belongs to me as well.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Therefore... the thing you must believe in 
is one and only.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
It's no illusion, nor is it a mere trifle. 
—What is it, then?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hah...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Splendidly done.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ――Now then, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I'm in a good mood.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I shall grant them a reward as well.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... I wonder if Lady Orfevre is 
getting a good, restful break.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you're thinking about Lady Orfevre 
again! Didn't we agree that today we'd 
just have fun by ourselves—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Insolence.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainers
text_block_list.text: L-Lord Orfe...!?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You subjects, at all times— no matter 
when—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Think of me. That shall be your reward 
for tonight."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Got it?

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainers
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh!! I-I am truly honored...!!

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
Um, Lady Orfevre...! Would you care for 
some stollen?

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'll bring your footstool right 
away...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Orfevre herself... seemed to wear an 
unusually gentle expression on that 
Christmas night.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —That night, I had a dream.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: So. What is it that you desire?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: It is a holy night.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "I shall bestow a reward upon you myself."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: No need for hesitation. Speak your mind.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
There is nothing that the King cannot 
obtain.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre maintains a magnanimous demeanor. 
Normally, one would wish for victory in 
the Arima Kinen or the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe, but...
choice_data_list:
(Maybe I should try to catch them off 
guard?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She must be eagerly anticipating what kind 
of wish will leap forth.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: What is the matter? Speak.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
A castle, subjects, jewels, power, 
glory... Ah, a throne sounds quite 
intriguing as well.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "Or do you lack all desire?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The one thing I can never give up going 
forward... Looking at her face, it 
suddenly came to me. So that she'll never 
have to be alone again――"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heh heh... Hahaha.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I'm surprised. Demanding the most valuable 
thing in this world.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: What a greedy man.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: What a greedy woman.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Do not be so hasty. Your desire is 
overreaching."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Well, just wait patiently. Do so, and it 
shall... fall naturally into your hands."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Christmas night... slowly drew to 
a close.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —That night, I had a dream.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
It has no shape. And yet... I can feel the 
deep... bottomlessly deep feelings being 
offered to me—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Feelings as exquisite and intricate as 
gold filigree filled my heart.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...I see. So "you" were one as well, were 
you?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Worry not. I shall accomplish everything 
alongside him.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Get some good rest.
